speaker: Doctor
text: I am ready to assist. Please describe your symptoms in detail, specifically focusing on the nature of your vomiting and chest pain, and when they began. REQUEST TEST: Electrocardiogram (ECG) to rule out cardiac issues.

speaker: Doctor
text: The ECG results are normal. Given your persistent vomiting and chest pain, have you noticed any changes in your stool color or abdominal pain, and are you experiencing dizziness or fainting? REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count AND REQUEST TEST: Liver_Function_Tests.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the blood work; since your counts and liver function are normal, do you notice any epigastric pain, especially after eating, and are you seeing clay-colored stools? REQUEST TEST: Abdominal_Imaging_Ultrasound.

speaker: Doctor
text: The ultrasound of your abdomen is normal, and your labs remain clear. Have you noticed any dark, coffee-ground material in your vomit or stool, and do you have a history of gallstones or ulcers? REQUEST TEST: Upper Gastrointestinal Series (Barium Swallow) to evaluate for obstruction or bleeding.

speaker: Doctor
text: The Upper GI series is normal, so we have ruled out obstruction, bleeding, or structural ulcers. Given your persistent vomiting and chest pain with all other systems clear, have you noticed any difficulty swallowing food or liquid, or a sensation of food getting stuck in your chest? REQUEST TEST: Esophageal_Manometry.

speaker: Doctor
text: The esophageal manometry is normal, ruling out motility disorders like achalasia. Have you experienced severe, tearing chest or back pain that started suddenly, or have you been taking NSAIDs recently? REQUEST TEST: Abdominal_CTA. REQUEST IMAGES: Abdominal_CTA_Results.

speaker: Doctor
text: The abdominal CTA and all previous imaging have been normal, which effectively rules out aortic dissection, severe gallbladder disease, and peptic ulcer perforation. Have you noticed any weight loss, night sweats, or a specific pain pattern that radiates to your back or between your shoulder blades? REQUEST TEST: Upper Endoscopy (EGD) to visually inspect the esophagus and stomach for malignancy or subtle inflammation not seen on imaging.

speaker: Doctor
text: The endoscopy results are normal, which rules out malignancy, severe esophagitis, or peptic ulcers. Since cardiac, abdominal, and structural esophageal causes have been excluded, have you experienced severe chest pain while resting, accompanied by shortness of breath or sweating? REQUEST TEST: Exercise_Stress_Test.

speaker: Doctor
text: The exercise stress test was normal, effectively ruling out ischemic heart disease. Given the persistent vomiting and chest pain with a completely normal workup for cardiac, structural, and inflammatory causes, have you noticed any worsening pain in the last few days despite pain medication, or any fever? REQUEST TEST: Serum_Amylase_AND_Request_TEST: Serum_Lipase.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Functional Dyspepsia with associated non-cardiac chest pain.
